title: abs()
description: Returns the absolute value of a number, or the magnitude when the argument is complex.

title: aiter()
description: Returns an asynchronous iterator from an async iterable, equivalent to calling __aiter__().

title: all()
description: Returns True when every element of the iterable is truthy, including vacuously for an empty iterable.

title: anext()
description: Awaits and returns the next item from an async iterator, with an optional default when exhausted.

title: any()
description: Returns True when at least one element of the iterable is truthy, otherwise False for an empty iterable.

title: ascii()
description: Returns a repr-style ASCII-safe string with non-ASCII characters escaped via \x, \u, or \U sequences.

title: bin()
description: Converts an integer to a binary string literal prefixed with 0b that can be evaluated as Python code.

title: bool()
description: Converts a value to True or False using Python's standard truth-testing procedure.

title: breakpoint()
description: Enters the debugger at the call site by invoking sys.breakpointhook(), defaulting to pdb.set_trace().

title: bytearray()
description: Creates a mutable array of byte values in the range 0–255 from an optional source.

title: bytes()
description: Creates an immutable sequence of byte values from an integer size, iterable, buffer, or encoded string.

title: callable()
description: Reports whether an object appears callable, including functions, classes, and instances with __call__().

title: chr()
description: Returns the one-character string for a Unicode code point from 0 through 0x10FFFF.

title: classmethod()
description: Decorator that binds a method to the class, passing the class object as the first argument instead of self.

title: compile()
description: Compiles source code into a code object suitable for exec() or eval() with a chosen execution mode.

title: complex()
description: Constructs a complex number from numeric or string input, or from separate real and imaginary parts.

title: delattr()
description: Deletes a named attribute from an object when deletion is permitted, equivalent to del object.name.

title: dict()
description: Creates a dictionary from keyword arguments, an existing mapping, or an iterable of key-value pairs.
